ns2:course.label: Senior Honors Seminar
ns2:course.description: Continuation of PSYC 398, this course assists students in the Psychology Honors Program with the researching and writing of an undergraduate honors thesis, under supervision of a faculty member, on a problem of appropriate scope and character. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: PSYC 398.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: PSYC 398.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Psychology department.
